primitives.name: Data Integrity Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Integrity rule Do not pretend blocked, metadata-only, fixture-backed, license-required, or partner-required data is active.
primitives.assumptions: All blocked data is inactive by design; metadata-only data lacks actionable signal.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When I(B) = 0, data is considered invalid for active use.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's exclusion prior in Bayesian inference where blocked data contributes zero probability mass.
layer2.telemetry: Active data count vs. blocked data count ratio

primitives.assumptions: Rights gates are binary; activation depends on license and partner status.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R = false, S is undefined or zero.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE's source queue logic; activation kernel is conditional on rights validation.
layer2.telemetry: Number of activated sources per rights category

primitives.name: Human Action Minimization Queue
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Human action minimized Every blocked source is isolated into rights/activation/outreach queues with fallback source, expected next action, and product impact.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Q': 'Queue state (set of blocked sources)', 'F': 'Fallback source identifier (string)', 'A': 'Expected next action (event type)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each blocked source has deterministic fallback and action path.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Q is empty, system enters idle mode.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's state transition engine; queue state mirrors decision-card contract execution paths.
layer2.telemetry: Average time to resolve blocked source queue
